**NVIDIA Open Model License**, version dated 2025-10-24. The preamble states the models are usable in products. **Section 2.4**: "NVIDIA claims no ownership rights in outputs. You are responsible for outputs and their subsequent uses." No attribution requirement applies to outputs (Section 3 attribution covers redistributing the model itself). **OPERATOR CLEARANCE 2026-10-10** (patrick@simnova.com): "approved, clear them under 2.4". Caveat recorded, not resolved: the SOMA-RP-v1.1 training data (proprietary Bones Rigplay, 700 h) has unpublished terms, per docs/openclinxr/scene-closure-2026-09-09/evidence/sc-10.md; NVIDIA's provenance claim was read, not independently verified.
Generated joint-motion clips (SOMA30) for the stop-in-place publishing pass. Model outputs of a locally run checkpoint, not redistributed weights.
2026-10-10 (operator clearance date; clips land in shipped GLBs via the wt/s1-stop publishing pass)
**Keep.** Cleared for shipped bytes under the Section 2.4 output grant plus the 2026-10-10 operator ruling.
